annotations.text:
Click ENTER NYX. It plays one of six entry animations, drawn at random — press it again and you get a different one.

That randomness is the point: the way in is never the same twice.

All six, side by side. Click one to replay it big, or Surprise me to draw at random.

Every entry is one of these — the same 1200ms, the same easing, six different mechanics.

Colour is one function of one angle: fix lightness and chroma, vary hue. That is how a hundred colours stay in tune instead of turning to noise.

Four of the eight station hues are already tokens in the app.
